datasets.name: ds_spend_daily
queryLines:
WITH
genie_rows AS (
  SELECT
    u.usage_date,
    u.workspace_id,
    u.account_id,
    u.cloud,
    u.sku_name,
    u.usage_unit,
    u.usage_end_time,
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_name,
    CASE WHEN u.identity_metadata.run_as LIKE '%@%' THEN 'User' ELSE 'Service principal' END AS principal_type,
    CASE u.usage_metadata.genie.surface
      WHEN 'GENIE_CODE'   THEN 'Genie Code'
      WHEN 'GENIE_ONE'    THEN 'Genie One'
      WHEN 'GENIE_AGENTS' THEN 'Genie Agents'
      ELSE COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'Other')
    END AS product,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 'Free' ELSE 'Billed' END AS billing_type,
    u.usage_quantity AS dbus
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max
),
genie_priced AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    CASE WHEN r.billing_type = 'Billed'
         THEN COALESCE(ap.pricing.default, lp.pricing.effective_list.default) END AS billed_unit_price_usd,
    CASE WHEN r.billing_type = 'Billed'
         THEN r.dbus * COALESCE(ap.pricing.default, lp.pricing.effective_list.default)
         ELSE 0 END AS billed_cost_usd
  FROM genie_rows r
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.account_prices ap
    ON  ap.account_id = r.account_id
    AND ap.sku_name = r.sku_name
    AND ap.cloud = r.cloud
    AND ap.usage_unit = r.usage_unit
    AND ap.currency_code = 'USD'
    AND r.usage_end_time >= ap.price_start_time
    AND (ap.price_end_time IS NULL OR r.usage_end_time < ap.price_end_time)
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON  lp.sku_name = r.sku_name
    AND lp.cloud = r.cloud
    AND lp.usage_unit = r.usage_unit
    AND lp.currency_code = 'USD'
    AND r.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
    AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR r.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time)
),
proxy_sku AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, MAX_BY(sku_name, usage_end_time) AS sku_name
  FROM genie_rows WHERE billing_type = 'Billed' GROUP BY workspace_id
),
proxy_sku_cloud AS (
  SELECT cloud, MAX_BY(sku_name, usage_end_time) AS sku_name
  FROM genie_rows WHERE billing_type = 'Billed' GROUP BY cloud
),
free_priced AS (
  SELECT
    f.workspace_id,
    f.cloud,
    f.account_id,
    COALESCE(ps.sku_name, pc.sku_name) AS proxy_sku_name
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id, cloud, account_id FROM genie_rows WHERE billing_type = 'Free') f
  LEFT JOIN proxy_sku ps ON ps.workspace_id = f.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN proxy_sku_cloud pc ON pc.cloud = f.cloud
),
free_unit_price AS (
  SELECT
    fp.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ap.pricing.default, lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS usd_per_dbu
  FROM free_priced fp
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.account_prices ap
    ON  ap.account_id = fp.account_id AND ap.sku_name = fp.proxy_sku_name AND ap.cloud = fp.cloud
    AND ap.currency_code = 'USD' AND ap.price_end_time IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON  lp.sku_name = fp.proxy_sku_name AND lp.cloud = fp.cloud
    AND lp.currency_code = 'USD' AND lp.price_end_time IS NULL
),
genie_costed AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CASE WHEN p.billing_type = 'Free'
         THEN p.dbus * fup.usd_per_dbu
         ELSE 0 END AS est_free_value_usd,
    CASE WHEN p.billing_type = 'Billed' THEN p.billed_unit_price_usd ELSE fup.usd_per_dbu END AS unit_price_usd
  FROM genie_priced p
  LEFT JOIN free_unit_price fup ON fup.workspace_id = p.workspace_id
),
workspaces AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest
),
period_days AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(DATEDIFF(LEAST(CAST(:period.max AS DATE), current_date()), CAST(:period.min AS DATE)) + 1, 1) AS days
)
SELECT
  c.usage_date,
  COALESCE(w.workspace_name, CAST(c.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,
  c.product,
  c.channel,
  c.principal_type,
  c.billing_type,
  SUM(c.dbus)               AS dbus,
  SUM(c.billed_cost_usd)    AS billed_cost_usd,
  SUM(c.est_free_value_usd) AS est_free_value_usd
FROM genie_costed c
LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.workspace_id = c.workspace_id
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY c.usage_date

datasets.name: ds_activity_daily
queryLines:
WITH
genie_messages AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(e.event_date AS DATE) AS event_date,
    e.workspace_id,
    e.initiated_by AS user_name,
    'Genie Code' AS product,
    'Genie Code' AS mode,
    'UI' AS channel
  FROM system.access.assistant_events e
  WHERE CAST(e.event_date AS DATE) BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    a.event_date,
    a.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(a.user_identity.email, a.user_identity.subject_name) AS user_name,
    CASE a.service_name WHEN 'aibiGenie' THEN 'Genie Agents' ELSE 'Genie One' END AS product,
    CASE
      WHEN a.action_name IN ('createAgenticResponse', 'genieCreateAgenticResponse') THEN 'Agent mode'
      WHEN a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' THEN 'Chat mode'
      ELSE 'Genie One chat'
    END AS mode,
    CASE WHEN a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND a.action_name LIKE 'genie%' THEN 'API' ELSE 'UI' END AS channel
  FROM system.access.audit a
  WHERE a.event_date BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max
    AND a.response.status_code = 200
    AND (
      (a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND a.action_name IN (
          'createConversationMessage', 'createAgenticResponse',
          'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage',
          'genieCreateAgenticResponse'))
      OR (a.service_name = 'genieChat' AND a.action_name = 'createGenieChatResponse')
    )
),
workspaces AS (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest)
SELECT
  m.event_date,
  COALESCE(w.workspace_name, CAST(m.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,
  m.product,
  m.mode,
  m.channel,
  m.user_name,
  COUNT(*) AS messages
FROM genie_messages m
LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.workspace_id = m.workspace_id
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY m.event_date

    r.*,
    CASE WHEN r.billing_type = 'Billed'
         THEN COALESCE(ap.pricing.default, lp.pricing.effective_list.default) END AS billed_unit_price_usd,
    CASE WHEN r.billing_type = 'Billed'
         THEN r.dbus * COALESCE(ap.pricing.default, lp.pricing.effective_list.default)

  FROM genie_rows r

    AND ap.cloud = r.cloud

    AND ap.currency_code = 'USD'
    AND r.usage_end_time >= ap.price_start_time
    AND (ap.price_end_time IS NULL OR r.usage_end_time < ap.price_end_time)
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON  lp.sku_name = r.sku_name
    AND lp.cloud = r.cloud
    AND lp.usage_unit = r.usage_unit
    AND lp.currency_code = 'USD'
    AND r.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
    AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR r.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time)

  FROM genie_rows WHERE billing_type = 'Billed' GROUP BY workspace_id
),

  FROM genie_rows WHERE billing_type = 'Billed' GROUP BY cloud
),
free_priced AS (
  SELECT
    f.workspace_id,
    f.cloud,
    f.account_id,
    COALESCE(ps.sku_name, pc.sku_name) AS proxy_sku_name
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id, cloud, account_id FROM genie_rows WHERE billing_type = 'Free') f
  LEFT JOIN proxy_sku ps ON ps.workspace_id = f.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN proxy_sku_cloud pc ON pc.cloud = f.cloud
),

  SELECT
    fp.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ap.pricing.default, lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS usd_per_dbu
  FROM free_priced fp
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.account_prices ap

    AND ap.currency_code = 'USD' AND ap.price_end_time IS NULL

    AND lp.currency_code = 'USD' AND lp.price_end_time IS NULL

  SELECT
    p.*,

         THEN p.dbus * fup.usd_per_dbu
         ELSE 0 END AS est_free_value_usd,

),
period_days AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(DATEDIFF(LEAST(CAST(:period.max AS DATE), current_date()), CAST(:period.min AS DATE)) + 1, 1) AS days
),
per_user AS (
  SELECT
    user_name,
    MAX_BY(workspace_id, dbus) AS primary_workspace_id,
    MAX_BY(product, dbus)      AS primary_product,
    SUM(CASE WHEN billing_type = 'Billed' THEN dbus ELSE 0 END) AS billed_dbus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN billing_type = 'Free'   THEN dbus ELSE 0 END) AS free_dbus,
    SUM(billed_cost_usd)    AS billed_cost_usd,
    SUM(est_free_value_usd) AS est_free_value_usd
  FROM genie_costed
  WHERE principal_type = 'User'
  GROUP BY user_name
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT percentile_approx(billed_cost_usd, 0.75) AS p75 FROM per_user WHERE billed_cost_usd > 0
)
SELECT
  u.user_name,
  COALESCE(w.workspace_name, CAST(u.primary_workspace_id AS STRING)) AS primary_workspace,
  u.primary_product,
  u.billed_dbus,
  u.free_dbus,
  u.billed_cost_usd,
  u.est_free_value_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN u.billed_cost_usd <= 0 THEN '1 AI beginners'
    WHEN u.billed_cost_usd <= c.p75 THEN '2 AI practitioners'
    ELSE '3 AI power users'
  END AS tier,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ws.ws_users DESC, u.primary_workspace_id) AS workspace_rank
FROM per_user u
CROSS JOIN cutoff c
JOIN (SELECT primary_workspace_id, COUNT(*) AS ws_users FROM per_user GROUP BY 1) ws
  ON ws.primary_workspace_id = u.primary_workspace_id
LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.workspace_id = u.primary_workspace_id

  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id, cloud, account_id FROM genie_rows WHERE billing_type = 'Free') f
  LEFT JOIN proxy_sku ps ON ps.workspace_id = f.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN proxy_sku_cloud pc ON pc.cloud = f.cloud
),
free_unit_price AS (
  SELECT
    fp.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ap.pricing.default, lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS usd_per_dbu
  FROM free_priced fp
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.account_prices ap
    ON  ap.account_id = fp.account_id AND ap.sku_name = fp.proxy_sku_name AND ap.cloud = fp.cloud
    AND ap.currency_code = 'USD' AND ap.price_end_time IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON  lp.sku_name = fp.proxy_sku_name AND lp.cloud = fp.cloud
    AND lp.currency_code = 'USD' AND lp.price_end_time IS NULL
),
genie_costed AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CASE WHEN p.billing_type = 'Free'
         THEN p.dbus * fup.usd_per_dbu
         ELSE 0 END AS est_free_value_usd,
    CASE WHEN p.billing_type = 'Billed' THEN p.billed_unit_price_usd ELSE fup.usd_per_dbu END AS unit_price_usd
  FROM genie_priced p
  LEFT JOIN free_unit_price fup ON fup.workspace_id = p.workspace_id
),
workspaces AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest
),
period_days AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(DATEDIFF(LEAST(CAST(:period.max AS DATE), current_date()), CAST(:period.min AS DATE)) + 1, 1) AS days
),
per_user AS (
  SELECT user_name, SUM(billed_cost_usd) AS billed_cost_usd
  FROM genie_costed WHERE principal_type = 'User' GROUP BY user_name
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT percentile_approx(billed_cost_usd, 0.75) AS p75 FROM per_user WHERE billed_cost_usd > 0
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT
    u.*,
    CASE
      WHEN u.billed_cost_usd <= 0 THEN '1 AI beginners'
      WHEN u.billed_cost_usd <= c.p75 THEN '2 AI practitioners'
      ELSE '3 AI power users'
    END AS tier
  FROM per_user u CROSS JOIN cutoff c
)
SELECT
  t.tier,
  COUNT(*) AS users,
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS pct_users,
  SUM(t.billed_cost_usd) AS billed_cost_usd,
  SUM(t.billed_cost_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(t.billed_cost_usd)) OVER (), 0) AS pct_spend,
  percentile_approx(t.billed_cost_usd, 0.5)  * 30 / MAX(d.days) AS median_monthly_cost_usd,
  percentile_approx(t.billed_cost_usd, 0.75) * 30 / MAX(d.days) AS p75_monthly_cost_usd,
  SUM(t.billed_cost_usd) * 30 / MAX(d.days) AS projected_monthly_cost_usd
FROM tiered t
CROSS JOIN period_days d
GROUP BY t.tier
ORDER BY t.tier

    END AS product,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel,
    CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 'Free' ELSE 'Billed' END AS billing_type,

),

  LEFT JOIN proxy_sku ps ON ps.workspace_id = f.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN proxy_sku_cloud pc ON pc.cloud = f.cloud
),
free_unit_price AS (
  SELECT
    fp.workspace_id,
    COALESCE(ap.pricing.default, lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS usd_per_dbu
  FROM free_priced fp
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.account_prices ap
    ON  ap.account_id = fp.account_id AND ap.sku_name = fp.proxy_sku_name AND ap.cloud = fp.cloud
    AND ap.currency_code = 'USD' AND ap.price_end_time IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
    ON  lp.sku_name = fp.proxy_sku_name AND lp.cloud = fp.cloud
    AND lp.currency_code = 'USD' AND lp.price_end_time IS NULL
),
genie_costed AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CASE WHEN p.billing_type = 'Free'
         THEN p.dbus * fup.usd_per_dbu
         ELSE 0 END AS est_free_value_usd,
    CASE WHEN p.billing_type = 'Billed' THEN p.billed_unit_price_usd ELSE fup.usd_per_dbu END AS unit_price_usd
  FROM genie_priced p
  LEFT JOIN free_unit_price fup ON fup.workspace_id = p.workspace_id
),
workspaces AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest
),
period_days AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(DATEDIFF(LEAST(CAST(:period.max AS DATE), current_date()), CAST(:period.min AS DATE)) + 1, 1) AS days
),
top_ids AS (
  SELECT user_name FROM genie_costed
  GROUP BY user_name HAVING SUM(billed_cost_usd) > 0
  ORDER BY SUM(billed_cost_usd) DESC LIMIT 15
)
SELECT c.user_name, c.principal_type, c.product, SUM(c.billed_cost_usd) AS billed_cost_usd
FROM genie_costed c
JOIN top_ids t ON t.user_name = c.user_name
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY billed_cost_usd DESC

lines:
#### Notes

- **Pricing:** account price (system.billing.account_prices) when available, otherwise list price. Genie's 25% promo is already applied in billed DBUs.
- **Free usage at post-promo price:** free Genie DBUs priced at the workspace's billed Genie SKU with no promo discount. Estimate; does not subtract the free monthly allowance.
- **Scope:** Genie LLM costs only. Compute that Genie triggers (for example, SQL warehouses) is billed separately and is planned for Phase 2.
